title: Agriculture Increases Carbon Dioxide Emissions
definition: Agriculture contributes to CO2 emissions primarily through land-use change (deforestation for cultivation), soil organic matter oxidation, and the energy-intensive production of inputs like fertilizers and machinery.
importanceInUpsc: Essential for GS Paper III (Environment/Agriculture) and GS Paper I (Geography). UPSC frequently tests the distinction between CO2 (land use) and CH4/N2O (biological processes) in agriculture.
learningOutcomes: Master foundational concepts and mechanisms of Agriculture Increases Carbon Dioxide Emissions.
Evaluate spatial distribution, institutional frameworks, and policy dimensions.
Apply high-yield mnemonics to solve tricky Prelims and Mains questions.
prerequisites: Land Use, Land-Use Change, and Forestry (LULUCF)
